name: Lyla
source:
Human class.
A caring and considerate girl the whole human class looks up to as a leader.
Trusted even by the professors, Lyla is a rare model student among an academy full of misfits.
While she's of the highest social standing in the human class, she never flaunts her status and treats everybody as equals.
She shares a dorm room with Emil and is her closest confidant.
